rule: The owner, 2026-11-16: every asset (font, image, audio) has a known source, and an unknown right blocks -- it is never assumed. A source is known only when it is listed here with the basis it rests on. Each basis was read on the date given; no lawyer reviewed any of them (legal_review).

customer_upload.right: the customer's own file, uploaded in the conversation and placed by the customer's own answer
customer_upload.basis: the approved brief binds the attachment by id and sha256 (discovery.requirements_text); the worker serves exactly those bytes
customer_upload.legal_review: none; the customer is not yet asked to declare the right to the file (an approval-flow change, the owner's decision)

platform_generated.right: generated for this build by the platform's image model, black-forest-labs/flux-schnell on Replicate, released under Apache-2.0
platform_generated.basis: https://replicate.com/black-forest-labs/flux-schnell -- "Released under the apache-2.0 licence, the model can be used for personal, scientific, and commercial purposes."

authored_svg.right: drawn as code in this build (an inline SVG, an SVG data URI or an .svg file of the build)
authored_svg.basis: the generated repository is text only; an SVG in it was written by the build, not copied from a file
authored_svg.legal_review: none; a drawing can still copy a protected mark, and no static check reads that

google_fonts.right: open source licences (SIL Open Font License, Apache, Ubuntu Font License); commercial use allowed
google_fonts.basis: https://developers.google.com/fonts/faq -- "all Google Fonts are open source and are without cost"; "you can use them commercially"

build_served.right: a path the build serves itself
build_served.basis: the generated repository is text only: what it serves is text it wrote, a platform placeholder, or bytes embedded in a file -- and embedded bytes (a data: URI, a long base64 literal) are judged on their own and are unknown
build_served.legal_review: none; a path whose file does not exist is a broken link, which the visual check reports, not a right

google_maps_embed.right: a Google map embedded in an iframe; usage of the Maps Embed API is free of charge, under the Google Maps Platform Terms of Service
google_maps_embed.basis: https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/embed/get-started -- "Place an interactive map or Street View panorama on your web page with Maps Embed API"; https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/embed/usage-and-billing -- "Maps Embed usage is available at no charge"
google_maps_embed.legal_review: none; the Google Maps Platform Terms of Service were not read
